text: Playing this game on my own was impossible to do in one sitting. I desperately gasped after something real to look at after 20, or so minutes, because it felt suffocating. In order to complete the game I had to hold my breath as I progressed. After I ran out of air, I'd have to escape and take a real breather. The graphics look really good and it utilizes the Source Enging to it's fullest potential to deliver something unseen before. It does this at the same time as it provides solid performance. You get to approach this game with both melee and different weapons. Each one feels distinctly unique and fun to use. The guns are not restricted to only shooting, since they can be thrown, providing a useful stun if you've run out of ammo. Ammunition is pretty rare to come by, so you'll see yourself using anything to win a fight. The melee combat is where this game shines, though. It's one of the first that defined a proper melee combat system in first person. It's complex, fun and rewarding as you learn to use it. You dodge, block, kick and punch your way through enemies. This game would be nothing without it's story. It's a part of what makes it so hallucinating. If you feel like it's normal, then you're not. An absolutely great game which I definitely can't reccomend enough. The price is ludicrous at 9,99€ for this masterpiece. At sales it goes down by 90% to 0,99€. You have literally nothing to lose but your sanity, if you isolate yourself with this game. Don't isolate yourself with this game. Remeber that , or society will probably have to euthanize you for your own good.

text: I'd write a funny review about how "Haha HITLER Haha funny" but i actually really enjoy this game.  As of writing this i've only played 30 mins of the game and i've loved every second. Its fast paced, requires careful use of ammo and in turn can be very rewarding. The blood and gore is unlimited as the second you start the game you are greeted with dark and twisted horror themes that a lot of mainstream games avoid. For example,one of these is COD World at war. I'd argue that the zombies in that are a lot different to the ones in this game, but not necessarily better or worse. The zombies in waw are easy to kill and inflict minor damage singled out, whilst in this, they can catch you off guard and do serious damage, that's not to say that their hard to kill, the fact that they can swarm you can create a bigger challenge. The fact that this game is multiplayer just adds to the experience. If you like a strategy based survival game with very rewarding outcomes, i cant stress enough, Buy This Game!
